description: Independent signal-peptide classifier trained on 7610 human SwissProt N-termini, applied to the four ITIH5 isoforms
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_predict
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score, roc_curve, average_precision_score
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

def uniprot_stream(query, fields, limit=4000):
    out=[]; r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":query,"format":"json","size":500,"fields":fields},timeout=200)
    if r.status_code!=200: return []
    while True:
        out+=r.json()["results"]
        m=re.search(r'<(.*?)>; rel="next"', r.headers.get("Link",""))
        if not m or len(out)>=limit: break
        r=requests.get(m.group(1),timeout=200)
        if r.status_code!=200: break
    return out[:limit]

pos=uniprot_stream("reviewed:true AND organism_id:9606 AND ft_signal:*","accession,sequence",4000)
neg=uniprot_stream("reviewed:true AND organism_id:9606 NOT ft_signal:* NOT ft_transmem:*","accession,sequence",4000)
drop={"Q86UX2","P19827","P19823","Q06033","Q14624"}
P=[(e["primaryAccession"],e["sequence"]["value"][:30]) for e in pos if len(e["sequence"]["value"])>=30 and e["primaryAccession"] not in drop]
N=[(e["primaryAccession"],e["sequence"]["value"][:30]) for e in neg if len(e["sequence"]["value"])>=30 and e["primaryAccession"] not in drop]
print("training set:",len(P),"positives (annotated SP),",len(N),"negatives (no SP, no TM)")

AA="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"; idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def feats(s30):
    s=[a if a in idx else "A" for a in s30]
    oh=np.zeros(600)
    for i,a in enumerate(s): oh[i*20+idx[a]]=1
    v=np.array([KD[a] for a in s]); win=np.array([v[i:i+7].mean() for i in range(len(v)-6)])
    hyd=set("AVLIMFWC"); best=cur=0
    for a in s:
        cur=cur+1 if a in hyd else 0; best=max(best,cur)
    extra=np.array([win.max(),win[:12].mean(),v[:10].mean(),best,
                    sum(1 for a in s[:8] if a in "KR"),sum(1 for a in s[:8] if a in "DE"),
                    sum(1 for a in s if a=="P")/30, sum(1 for a in s if a in "DE")/30])
    return np.concatenate([oh,extra])

X=np.array([feats(s) for _,s in P]+[feats(s) for _,s in N]); y=np.array([1]*len(P)+[0]*len(N))
clf=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),LogisticRegression(C=0.3,max_iter=4000))
prob=cross_val_predict(clf,X,y,cv=StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=0),method="predict_proba")[:,1]
auc=roc_auc_score(y,prob); ap=average_precision_score(y,prob); acc=((prob>0.5).astype(int)==y).mean()
print(f"5-fold CV: ROC AUC = {auc:.4f}, average precision = {ap:.4f}, accuracy@0.5 = {acc:.4f}")

clf.fit(X,y)
seqs={}
for iso in ["Q86UX2-1","Q86UX2-2","Q86UX2-3","Q86UX2-4"]:
    seqs[iso]="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{iso}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
pq=clf.predict_proba(np.array([feats(seqs[k][:30]) for k in seqs]))[:,1]
print("\nP(signal peptide) for the four ITIH5 isoforms:")
rows=[]
for k,v in zip(seqs,pq):
    gt0=np.mean(prob[y==0]<v)*100; gt1=np.mean(prob[y==1]<v)*100
    print(f"  {k}: {v:.4f}  | above {gt0:5.1f}% of no-SP proteins, above {gt1:5.1f}% of SP proteins | {seqs[k][:30]}")
    rows.append(dict(isoform=k,P_signal_peptide=round(float(v),4),pct_above_noSP=round(gt0,1),
                     pct_above_SP=round(gt1,1),Nterm30=seqs[k][:30],
                     Phobius="SP yes" if k in ("Q86UX2-1","Q86UX2-2") else "no SP, no TM"))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
fpr,tpr,_=roc_curve(y,prob)
ax[0].plot(fpr,tpr,color="#2b6cb0",lw=2,label=f"AUC = {auc:.3f}")
ax[0].plot([0,1],[0,1],"--",color="grey",lw=1)
ax[0].set_xlabel("false positive rate"); ax[0].set_ylabel("true positive rate")
ax[0].set_title(f"Cross-validated performance on {len(y)} human SwissProt N-termini",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=9,frameon=False)
ax[1].hist(prob[y==0],bins=50,alpha=0.6,color="#4a5568",density=True,label=f"no signal peptide (n={(y==0).sum()})")
ax[1].hist(prob[y==1],bins=50,alpha=0.6,color="#c53030",density=True,label=f"annotated signal peptide (n={(y==1).sum()})")
cols=["#9b2c2c","#dd6b20","#2b6cb0","#2f855a"]
ymax=ax[1].get_ylim()[1]
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(zip(seqs,pq)):
    ax[1].axvline(v,color=cols[i],lw=2)
    ax[1].annotate(f"{k}\n{v:.3f}",xy=(v,ymax*(0.92-0.21*i)),fontsize=8,color=cols[i],
                   ha="left" if v<0.5 else "right", va="top")
ax[1].set_xlabel("P(signal peptide)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("density")
ax[1].set_title("ITIH5 isoforms scored against the training distributions",fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False,loc="upper center")
plt.suptitle("Independent signal-peptide classifier (human SwissProt, ITIH family withheld) applied to ITIH5 isoforms",fontsize=11.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv("/agent/jobs/751146a9-dc23-49c8-ac3a-da13249e67c2/provenance/itih5_sp_classifier_scores.csv",index=False)
print("\n",pd.DataFrame(rows).to_string(index=False))
